title: If the world economy were $100: America gets $26. India gets $3
description: If the whole world economy were 100 dollars, how many would your country get? Real World Bank data for 2024.
source: World Bank, GDP in current US dollars (2024, share of the sum of 200 economies), data.worldbank.org/indicator/NY.GDP.MKTP.CD; population via SP.POP.TOTL

segments.text: The whole world economy is one hundred dollars. America holds twenty-six.
India has almost one in five people on Earth. It gets three.
Every other country shares the last fifty.
How many dollars does your country get? Follow for more.
